summary: Current OpenCode Console documentation lists Exo Free (exo-free) with free input, output and cached reads for a limited time; collected data may be used to improve the model, so avoid sensitive inputs. The old Zen docs URL returns 404; current v2 Console docs show https://opencode.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions. However, repeated responses from both https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/models and https://opencode.ai/inference/v1/models omit exo-free, despite the current docs and official model-reference site listing it. Successful selector/API availability is unresolved. General Console setup instructs adding billing details and credits, but the Exo-specific funding requirement remains unconfirmed. No end date or completed Exo request is known.
claim_steps: Read https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/models/ and sign in to OpenCode Console. General setup includes billing details and credits; Exo-specific funding requirements are unconfirmed.
In OpenCode V2, run /connect, choose the OpenCode pay-as-you-go provider and enter your API key locally.

Run /models to check whether Exo Free (exo-free) is selectable. Current docs show https://opencode.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions, but both live models catalogs omit exo-free; successful inference remains unconfirmed.
During the free period, collected data may be used to improve the model. Avoid sensitive inputs and check current pricing before use; the offer is limited-time.
